description: Frozen artifact set for the P02 release freeze receipt (docs/aegis/plans/2026-09-13-setos-release-execution.md §6). The set is data: extend it here, not in freeze_receipt.py. Paths are relative to the repo root; a path containing '*' is a glob and every matching file joins the set. Scope: every machine-consumed contract — schema, catalog, policy, preprocessing, label and protocol. The append-only ledgers (rights-manifest.jsonl, consent-manifest.jsonl, derivation-manifest.jsonl, source-shoots.jsonl) are deliberately NOT here: they are expected to grow as records are admitted, so freezing them would produce permanent false drift and would record a data snapshot as if it were a contract. Their schema is what is frozen, not their contents.

artifacts.note: v1/v2 contract manifests and their JSON Schemas. The preprocessing contract is embedded in the manifests (preprocessing_version + preprocessing block); there is no separate preprocessing file, so the glob is what freezes it.
Carries the rights_policy and human_gold_policy fields, so the dataset admission policy is frozen with the catalog.

The §5.1 acceptance thresholds and metric definitions. Lowering a threshold here must be a versioned change (exit 2) with an impact list, not a silent edit; P02 item 3 requires this policy to be written before the locked test, and P02 item 4 requires it inside the freeze receipt.
The before/action/after episode contract (outcome, outcome_verifier, subject_continuity). Consumed by tools/release/build_episode_metrics.py, so a silent edit here would move a §5 producer.
Defines the split/cluster manifest. The FP_CORRECT cluster-level independence rule and split_disjointness both read cluster identity, so what a cluster IS has to be frozen.
Cluster record shape for the source-shoot/session grouping the cluster-level gates rely on.
Temporal sequence contract for the temporal and verify lanes.
Silver action-pair lane contract, consumed by train_silver_actions.py and convert_coreml.py.
Silver geometry lane contract, consumed by train_silver_actions.py and generate_camera_corruptions.py.
